rows.evidence: AS1Space P14 (called synchronously from Start P16) runs `while not AiDirector:Name__aefbf866() do Sleep(0) end` (i11 GETIMPORT Sleep, i13 CALL, i14 JUMPBACK) before its only read of spaceEnemyCountPerVariant (i130). When the director is not ready at the entry, the read follows a yield of the instance and an engine re-write of the parameter would restore the template list (R15 F6); the engine writer owns it on every write. Same shape as railjack.corpus_fighter_limit_scale.
